name: Fernanfloo Dresses Up
look: Two photos side by side under a white caption space. Left: a slim young man with dark hair in a gray graphic hoodie and plaid pajama pants stands awkwardly by a wooden wardrobe. Right: the same man, hair neatly styled, poses confidently in a black suit and tie in a bright apartment.
use: Compares a sloppy, everyday version of something with a polished, upgraded one. The left photo gets the basic or casual version and the right the fancy one.
slots: the basic, casual version (above the left photo)
the fancy, upgraded version (above the right photo)
examples: Me when I have to call customer service
describe: guy in a hoodie and pajama pants then the same guy in a suit

origin: Named after the Salvadoran YouTuber Fernanfloo, shown casual and then dressed up in a suit.
